seoTitle: Gym in Baner, Pune | Ironclad Athletic Club
seoDescription: Strength and conditioning gym in Baner, Pune. 12,000 sq ft floor, 42 coached classes a week, nine coaches. First session free — no contracts.

hero.intro: 12,000 sq ft of open floor, nine coaches, and a class board that runs from 6 AM to 9 PM. No contracts at the door. Take a session first, decide after.

programmesIntro: Three tracks run every week. Members move between them freely — most people do two strength days and two conditioning days.

programmes.title: Power Up
programmes.body: Squat, hinge, press, pull — coached on the barbell from your first session. Six platforms, four competition racks, calibrated plates to 250 kg.

programmes.title: Be Flexible
programmes.body: Morning vinyasa, evening restorative, and a 75-minute mobility hour on Sundays that pairs with whatever you lifted that week.

programmes.title: Metcon 45
programmes.body: Forty-five minutes of mixed-modal work — bike, rower, barbell, carries — capped at twelve so the coach sees every rep. Three scaling levels on the board.

benefitsIntro: Things other gyms in Baner charge extra for. They come with the floor, from day one.

benefits.title: Movement screen
benefits.body: Overhead reach, hinge, squat depth, single-leg balance — the result writes your starting programme.

benefits.title: Written logbook
benefits.body: Loads, reps and RPE recorded each session, so progress is a number on a page rather than a feeling.

benefits.title: Coach review
benefits.body: Thirty minutes with your coach comparing the last twelve weeks and rewriting the next twelve.

benefits.title: Bring a friend
benefits.body: One guest pass a month, no notice needed. They train the same class as you, free.

todayHeading: Drop in on any class, free, once.
todayBody: Turn up ten minutes early with indoor shoes and a bottle. We'll put you with a coach and start you wherever you are today.
